defective_pattern: Writing refinement scripts with brittle regex patterns tailored only to a subset of tables (e.g. inferential regression tables) and assuming preceding scaffolding (like table note blocks) already exists on disk.
why_defective: Leaves early demographic and descriptive tables in inconsistent formats and silently skips tables lacking pre-existing note markers.
corrective_remedy: Build defensive, exhaustive table-by-table processors that iterate over all 45 tables, instantiate missing note blocks automatically, and map all demographic, descriptive, and inferential headers to standard APA Latin symbols.
